items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: Anyway, he got me and he got Vic

ctx.x: I was interrupting your story, asking you about the Hot Five. So then you came out to the West Coast, right?

Well, this guy... Like I said, Bespawn(?) and Hill, they called it the Original Dixieland Jazz Band. Now, I didn't know why they wanted to take that name. Because that was a famous name, you know. But they wanted to pick up on a famous name for some reason, for the simple reason that they didn't know what they was doing to start with, organizing the band. So they put this guy Toby Mitchell, give him the bankrolling to come to Louisiana to find some musicians that would go to Houston and rehearse and organize the…
